blocks.source_text: 人才推荐服务协议演示样例
虚构数据 仅供演示 不用于签署
blocks.translation: Fictional data for demonstration only. Not for execution.

blocks.source_text: 甲方：示例科技有限公司
blocks.translation: Party A: Example Technology Co., Ltd.

blocks.source_text: 乙方：示例人才服务有限公司
blocks.translation: Party B: Example Talent Services Co., Ltd.

blocks.source_text: 1. 乙方向甲方推荐候选人。服务费为人民币12,000元，仅在候选人正式入职后收取。
blocks.translation: 1. Party B shall refer candidates to Party A. A service fee of CNY 12,000 shall be payable only after the candidate commences employment.

blocks.source_text: 2. 甲方应在收到有效发票后10个工作日内付款，但已书面提出异议的金额除外。
blocks.translation: 2. Party A shall pay within 10 business days after receiving a valid invoice, except for any amount disputed in writing.

blocks.source_text: 收到有效发票后10个工作日内
blocks.translation: Within 10 business days after receiving a valid invoice

blocks.source_text: 书面提出异议的部分暂缓支付
blocks.translation: Payment of any portion disputed in writing shall be deferred
